svg.title: Timing flips the effect: bursts stimulate, constant exposure shuts down
svg.desc: Timing flips the effect: bursts stimulate, constant exposure shuts down. Kisspeptin-54, twice-daily injections, 2 weeks, Women with hypothalamic amenorrhea (2009): 10% of day-1 LH rise left on day 14. Kisspeptin-10, 8-hour daily infusion, 12 days, Healthy men (2026): 68% of day-1 LH rise left on day 12. Kisspeptin-10, continuous infusion, 5 days, Healthy men (2026): LH and FSH back to placebo level. TAK-448 analog, continuous, 14 days, Healthy men aged 50+ (2014): Testosterone below castration level by day 8. TAK-683 analog, continuous, 2 weeks, Healthy men (2013): Testosterone below castration level in 4 of 5.
